instruction: Could you clean up the table?

attempts.code:
go_home()
obs = observe()
mug = obs["objects"]["red_mug"]
target = obs["zones"]["cyan_tray"]

# Approach from above
move_to(mug["center"][0], mug["center"][1], mug["top_z"] + 0.1)
# Descend to grasp height
grasp_z = mug["top_z"] - 0.02

# Open gripper, then close to pick up

close_gripper()

# Check if gripped
if not observe()["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grip red_mug")

# Lift high to clear table
move_to(mug["center"][0], mug["center"][1], mug["top_z"] + 0.2)

# Move above target zone
move_to(target["center"][0], target["center"][1], target["center"][3] + 0.2)

# Descend to place height
place_z = target["center"][2] + 0.01
move_to(target["center"][0], target["center"][1], place_z)

# Open gripper to release
open_gripper()

# Lift to clear
move_to(target["center"][0], target["center"][1], target["center"][3] + 0.2)
